🎮 Full XI Control — switch between players for total control of your team.
  🎴 Squad Building — collect real football players and build your ultimate XI.
  🏆 Ranked Play — climb 10 divisions and prove you're the best.
  👕 Build Your Club — custom kit, ball, titles & stadium. Make it your own!

  LIKE GOALS

  🎉 10k LIKES =x2 Pack Odds Weekend

  ❤️ Inspired by FIFA, PES, and the legendary football games.
